sources.name: libretro-database Dreamcast cheats
sources.author: libretro-database contributors and the original Dreamcast cheat authors
sources.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 repository license; individual upstream code authors remain credited
sources.notes: The Dreamcast cheat folder is imported whole. Disc product codes come from the Redump metadata DAT of the same revision; Redump's short Sega codes (51036) are expanded to the IP.BIN form (MK-51036) and serial lists from the previous catalog are always kept. Blocks using unsupported code types, repeats or enable codes are excluded.

sources.name: MAME cheat collection (Pugsy's XML cheats)
sources.author: Pugsy and MAME cheat collection contributors
sources.license: MAME cheat XML collection by Pugsy and contributors; only plain SH4 main RAM writes are converted
sources.notes: Naomi, Naomi 2, Atomiswave and System SP romsets are matched against the arcade game table shipped with EmuCoreH (assets/catalog/arcade_games.json). Only unconditional run-state actions that write SH4 main RAM are converted to address/value codes; button conditions, ROM patches and one-shot actions are skipped.
